title: Sunflower motif
subtitle: A bright yellow sunflower with a brown bobble centre, 12 cm
excerpt: The sunflower motif builds a large round bobble centre in dark brown from a magic ring, then works a single outer ring of elongated treble petals in yellow. The contrast of the textured bobble centre against the smooth petals reads clearly at 12 cm. Used on cushions, tote bags, and as a stand-alone hoop decoration.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 5 (1890), sunflower and large flower motif chapter (Internet Archive). Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopedia of Needlework (1886), crochet flower construction.
heroPrompt: A crochet sunflower motif in bright yellow DK cotton with a dark brown bobble centre, 12 cm across, photographed flat on natural linen in soft summer daylight. 16 petals visible around the textured centre.

chartDefinition.title: Sunflower motif
chartDefinition.caption: Dark brown centre: magic ring, 3 rounds of bobble stitches. Yellow petal round: ch-3 sp between each bobble, 3tr petal into each sp. Final dc border.

glossaryTerms.definition: Multiple half-finished trebles worked into the same stitch and drawn together at the top, forming a raised bump. Sunflower centres are covered in bobbles to mimic seeds.

content.text: -textured centre disc from a magic ring outward in three rounds, then joins the yellow petal ring on the outer edge. The bobbles in the centre mimic sunflower seeds — the more tightly packed and consistently sized, the more convincing the effect. Working the centre in a slightly smaller hook than the petals (3.5 mm for the centre, 4 mm for the petals) keeps the centre compact and the petals open.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 8 g of yellow DK cotton, 5 g of dark brown. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished sunflower motif measures 12 cm across in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.
bobble (5tr-bob) — five trebles drawn together into one stitch.

Form a magic ring. Ch 1. Rnd 1: 6dc into ring. Sl st to join. (6 dc.) Rnd 2: Ch 1. 2 bobbles in each dc. Sl st to join. (12 bobbles.) Rnd 3: Ch 1. *Bobble. 2 bobbles in next.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st to join. (18 bobbles.) Rnd 4: Ch 1. Dc around the outer edge, spacing 16 dc evenly. Sl st to join. Fasten off brown.

Join yellow to any dc of the centre outer ring. *Ch 3. 3tr into the ch-3 sp (petal). Ch 3. Sl st into the next dc of the centre ring. Sl st into the next dc.* Repeat from * to * 7 more times to make 8 petals. For a fuller sunflower, repeat the 16-stitch centre ring and work 16 petals total — one petal per dc. Fasten off.

definition.title: Sunflower motif
definition.caption: Brown bobble centre: 3 rounds from magic ring to 18 bobbles. Yellow petals: ch-3/3tr/ch-3 into every other centre dc.

content.text: Weave in all ends. Steam-block the petals flat. The centre is three-dimensional and will stand slightly proud of the petal plane — this is correct.
Handwash in cool water. Lay flat to dry. The bobble centre holds its shape well after washing.
The poppy motif (crochet-flower-poppy) uses a different four-petal approach in red. The bee motif (crochet-animal-bee) pairs naturally with the sunflower for a summer meadow combination.
